description:
Port pi-coding-agent's non-TUI parts — enough to run a coding agent in Print and RPC modes.

Scope (children to be created when we approach this phase):
- JSONL session store + migrations (byte-compatible with upstream v3 — RESEARCH.md §4.4).
- File mutex Registry (one lock GenServer per absolute path).
- Core file tools: read, write, edit, ls.
- Bash tool (Port-based, streaming, pgid termination on abort).
- Search tools: grep (rg shell-out + fallback), find (glob).
- Print mode.
- RPC mode (JSON-lines stdin/stdout).
- CLI entry, arg parsing, cwd resolution, mode dispatch.

Definition of done: `mix pi --print "write hello world to foo.txt and cat it back"` works end-to-end and produces a session file readable by upstream `pi`. `mix pi --mode rpc` passes a JSON round-trip integration test.

Ref: RESEARCH.md §3.3, §4.4, §6 Phase 3.
title: Phase 3: octo_pi_coder — core (sessions, tools, Print/RPC)
